scope: What Microcoder's worker process (coder/tui/mcworker.coax) and its owner say to each other over the worker's standard input and output: one JSON object a line each way, with no spaces. The owners are Coder's terminal (coder/tui/microcoder.coax), the turn runner (coax/lib/agent/engine/run.coax), both through mcworker-client.coax, and Coder's memory (coder/tui/memory.coax) for embeddings.
captured: 2026-11-13, in a throwaway home, from the worker and the Coder CLI built from this tree before the codec (commit 21f7b9ada1). No hosted model was called: the model's and Vertex's answers were replayed with GW_REPLAY from recordings in the repository or from scripted answers. The same runs with both programs built on the codec gave the same bytes each way, apart from the journal file's name (its start time).
framing: A line ends with one line feed. A string is escaped as coax/lib/nostr/json.coax json_write_string does: a quote and a backslash behind a backslash, \n \r \t \b \f, any other byte under 32 as \u00XX, every other byte as it is. Members are written in the order given here; the readers find them by name in any order and skip members they do not know. The worker takes an owner's line as the first of stop, forget, embed, answer, task that fits; a line that fits none is skipped. An owner skips a worker's line of a kind it does not know.

endings.asked: the reply is a question for the person
endings.failed: refused or broken; text says why
endings.no_capacity: no model answered; text says why
endings.bad_replies: three answers in a row that fit no schema
endings.idle: three answers in a row with nothing to do and no reply

members.name: task
members.note: the message; a line whose task is missing, empty or no string is skipped; over 16384 bytes it ends failed

members.name: session
members.note: the owner's session ID, kept in the journal's context frame

members.name: cwd
members.note: the folder; missing, empty or over 4096 bytes the task ends failed

members.name: local
members.note: written only when true: the model server on this machine

members.name: sandbox
members.note: danger-full-access, read-only or workspace-write; missing or empty reads as danger-full-access; any other ends failed

members.name: policy.enabled
members.note: the owner runs under an approval policy

members.name: policy.allow
members.note: the effect that runs freely (0 read, 1 network, 2 write, 3 run); the worker keeps it in the journal only

members.name: policy.ceiling
members.note: the highest effect, 0 to 3; read only when enabled is true; out of range ends failed

members.name: policy.roots
members.note: the policy's folders, a line each; the worker keeps it in the journal only

members.name: gated
members.note: written only when true: each command waits for an answer line

members.name: model
members.note: written only when the owner names a model; not read for a local task

members.name: effort
members.note: written only when given: low, medium or high; anything else reads as low

members.name: answer
members.note: true runs the waiting command, false refuses it

members.name: ticket
members.note: the ask line's ticket; an answer for another ticket is ignored

members.name: why
members.note: written only when answer is false: the reason, refused when the owner gives none

members.name: stop
members.note: STOP the run; the worker takes a boolean of either value

members.name: forget
members.note: forget the conversation; the worker takes a boolean of either value

members.name: embed
members.note: the text to embed

members.name: query
members.note: written only when true: a query's embedding, else a document's

members.name: kind
members.note: the line's kind

members.name: path
members.note: the worker's journal file (AJR1). The first line a worker writes. The owner copies the line into the session log as it is

members.note: more of the reply

runs.name: coder-run
runs.what: coder run --engine micro --json: a command, then the reply, with the model's two answers replayed from coder/tui/fixtures/micro-replay (recorded from Vertex Gemini Flash on 2026-11-02)
runs.from: Coder's CLI (coder/tui/coder.coax) and the worker it started (coder/tui/mcworker.coax), both built before the codec; a recorder between them kept each end's lines. The owner's lines come first, then the worker's, each in its own order.
